summary: A static website with interactive components and a separate HTTP API sharing one typed contract.
description: Start with pages built ahead of time and add React islands where the page needs fresh API data. A Bun workspace keeps the Astro site, Node API and shared Effect HTTP contract separate, while the typed client catches contract changes on both sides. The base proves the connection with a health-status island. Product resources, authentication and storage are work you add after that slice.
seoDescription: An Astro site with React islands and a Node API sharing a typed Effect contract, for static pages that need live data.

projectExamples.title: Service status directory
projectExamples.description: Build static service pages with islands that fetch current status from your API. Add the service checks and status history as product work.

projectExamples.title: Public data explorer
projectExamples.description: Publish explanatory pages beside interactive filters backed by custom API resources. The shared contract keeps the filters and responses aligned.
